description: Handle a follow-up request to verify a completed edit.

scenario.initial_input: Fix the typo in message.txt: change helllo to hello.
scenario.hidden_goal: The agent should fix the typo, then handle a follow-up asking it to verify the file content.
rubric: Fixes the typo in the file.
Handles the follow-up by inspecting or otherwise verifying state.
Does not use unrelated memory or web tools.
Final communication is concise and grounded.
scripted_turns: Please verify the file now contains hello.

objective_commands.name: message_state
objective_commands.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; assert Path('message.txt').read_text() == 'hello sema\n'; print('ok')"
